svg.title: Toll-like receptor dimer
svg.desc: Toll-like receptor in membrane section: two horseshoe-shaped leucine-rich-repeat ectodomains close over a bound ligand (accent) in an m-shaped dimer, single transmembrane helices and paired cytoplasmic TIR domains.
